extracted.intended_audience: CIA internal management and planning staff (Chief, Executive & Planning Division; Operational Support Division; Deputy Director of Security), staff preparing OMB Circular A-44 implementation reports
extracted.subtask_short: management effectiveness and cost reduction goals
extracted.subtask_description: Drafting and reporting Management Effectiveness and Cost Reduction goals under OMB Circular A-44 for a CIA office for a specified fiscal period, including specific actions expected to increase efficiency and dollar savings. The document enumerates discrete operational changes and the expected benefits or savings to be realized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission of Management Effectiveness and Cost Reduction goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference is made to your memorandum dated 13 November 1970 calling for the submission of our Management Effectiveness and Cost Reduction goals for the last six months of fiscal year 1971.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Forward items for inclusion in the consolidated Office report; categorize items as Management Effectiveness or Cost Reduction when submitting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indicate expected savings for Cost Reduction goals
rubrics_metrics.description: The savings expected to be realized by the Cost Reduction goals are specifically indicated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For any proposed cost-reduction action, provide a specific estimate of expected savings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply savings from Management Effectiveness to increased production without added manpower
rubrics_metrics.description: The savings to be realized from those goals listed under Management Effectiveness will be applied to the production of more units of work necessitated by a continuing heavy caseload without any increase in manpower.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When describing management-effectiveness changes, state how time/efficiency gains will be reallocated to increase output without increasing staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Convert office space to vault area to consolidate safes
rubrics_metrics.description: To convert the office space now occupied by the Special Facilities Desk, Special Activities Branch, OSD, into a vault area. When this is accomplished, the Desk will be able to dispose of five four-drawer safes, making for a more efficient and more secure operation for this sensitive activity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should state the physical change (space conversion), the disposals enabled (e.g., number/type of safes removed), and the expected operational/security benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Convert a manifold carbon Agency form to NCR tablet form
rubrics_metrics.description: To convert to NCR paper, in tablet form, an Agency form which is a manifold carbon form currently being used quite extensively by the Special Facilities Desk of the Special Activities Branch of OSD.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain expected time savings from changing form format; quantify time-savings if possible and indicate how saved time will be applied to increased production.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procure desks with integrated safe cabinets to maximize space and control
rubrics_metrics.description: To procure four desks equipped with two-drawer safe cabinets in exchange for separate desks and safes now being utilized by Support Branch/OSD. The purpose of this exchange is to make maximum utilization of a confined area now occupied by the Support Branch in the Headquarters building.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the exchange (number/type of desks and safes), and list expected benefits: better utilization of confined space, more orderly storage of classified material, improved administrative control, and provision of additional supervisory workspace.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide more accessible secure access to security files (e.g., secure telecon)
rubrics_metrics.description: To initiate a more readily accessible means to obtain necessary information from security files, especially by those components of the Operational Support Division physically separated from the Headquarters building. This could be in the form of a secure telecon system that would provide the separated components with immediate access to pertinent information contained in the files and which would result in greater efficiency and more expeditious handling of sensitive assignments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Propose a secure communication/access solution (example: secure telecon), explain how it provides immediate access to file information for remote components, and state expected efficiency gains and impacts on handling assignments.
